an7.56:2.2: “Last night, mendicants, two deities resplendent in the late hours, lighting up the entire Vulture’s Peak, came to me. Coming up to me they bowed, and stood to one side. And standing to one side, mendicants, one deity said to me:
an7.56:2.4: The other deity said to me:
an7.56:2.5: ‘Sir, these nuns are well freed with no residue!’
an7.56:2.6: This is what those deities said, mendicants.
an7.56:2.7: Having said this, they bowed to me, paid respect, and vanished right there.”
